name: package-manifest-update
body: The release workflow regenerates the Homebrew formula (`Formula/kalide.rb`) and Scoop manifest (`bucket/kalide.json`) in their public forms — the formula with plain release-download `url` + `sha256` per macOS arch (Homebrew's standard downloader, no custom download strategy), the Scoop manifest with a standard `architecture` block (`64bit`, and `arm64` when released) of `url` + `hash` and no `pre_install` script — for the new version, `kalide-<os>-<arch>` asset URLs and SHA-256 checksums, and pushes them as a manifest-only commit to really-knows-ai/kalide (the CI manifest-only push carved out by global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag). All manifest URLs are public and tokenless (global.constraint.anonymous-install). AC: after a release, both files reference the new version and their checksums match the published assets; the generated files use the standard download forms (no download-strategy reference, no `pre_install`, no `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`/`KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`); the CI commit touches only files under `Formula/` and `bucket/`; CI creates no tags.
